note: Implemented code is evidence of state, not permission to overrule product intent recorded above it.

hard_guards.rule: Static PWA on GitHub Pages at /furniture-builder/; hash routing; update via in-app prompt, never by clearing site data.
No backend, accounts, cloud sync, customer-data upload, remote AI, paid service or runtime external API.
Dexie IndexedDB is the client store; the old localStorage-only clause is superseded for client-side storage only.
Migrations: marker inside the same transaction; missing-only writes; existing IDs win; legacy keys never deleted.
Never edit an existing Dexie version block; add a new version for any index/table change.
Keep every shipped JSON backup format readable; imports skip existing IDs; never silently migrate material or thickness.
Integer millimetres everywhere; unit conversion only at export/render boundaries.
Kerf is a full-length destroyed stripe; sub-kerf residuals are rejected, not absorbed.
Material, thickness, grain, rotation permission, stock quantity and trim constrain placement in generator and validator alike.
ABS edge banding is an annotation; cut sizes are never adjusted by it without a signed-off transform.
Deterministic seeded heuristic with lexicographic objective; never call results optimal.
Independent validator gates every result; validator shares no placement helpers with the generator.
Component generators live in the versioned registry; persisted data holds only ids, versions, parameters.
One-way parent-to-child parameter binding; stable instance IDs; pure composition operations.
Each furniture family uses a matching structural root; no fake carcass panels for surfaces.
3D, cut rows, BOM and Fusion consume one FurnitureModel; re-deriving geometry elsewhere is a defect.
Hardware is a requirement schedule, never emitted as cut panels; no drilling/part numbers claimed.
Only ready templates generate parts; planned ones are inert.
Ready recipe count and complete family count are reported separately; B24 stays Partial.
Legacy trees are adapted in memory; stored rows change only on explicit user Save.
3D interaction never changes part dimensions, IDs, quantities or materials.
Fusion export is a Python direct-model script; say 'unverified in Fusion'.
Vendor workbook adapters only from an inspected original file referenced by path and sha.
Heavy modules lazy-loaded; everything bundled; no CDN.
Smallest vertical slice; lint+typecheck+build+focused test; no E2E/refactor/polish by default; end with 'Skipped this iteration'.
Ledger status changes only with cited evidence; pushed != merged != deployed != live-verified; reported != executed.

proposed_guards.rule: No native Claude Flow/Ruflo files until a version is pinned and ADR-0030 is Accepted.
